name: DCI Vertical Marquee Widget for Elementor
author: DreamCode Infotech

sections.description:
DCI Vertical Marquee Widget for Elementor adds a stunning, scroll-reactive marquee cards section to your Elementor-powered website. Cards animate in a continuous loop — vertically or horizontally — and react to the visitor’s scroll direction in real time, creating an engaging, dynamic portfolio or gallery section.

Key Features

  • Dual marquee direction — vertical (up/down) or horizontal (left/right) with a single click.
  • Scroll-reactive animation — marquee direction reverses when the visitor scrolls up or down.
  • Multi-column layout — 1, 2, 3, or 4 columns (vertical) / rows (horizontal).
  • Card types — Tall, Square, and Short card heights, configurable per card.
  • Per-card controls — individually toggle image, tag, title, description, and add a custom link.
  • Alternate direction — odd columns/rows scroll opposite for visual depth.
  • Pause on hover — optionally freeze the animation when the cursor is over the widget.
  • Edge fade masks — smooth top/bottom or left/right gradient fades match your section background.
  • Full styling — typography, colours, border radius, border, box shadow, hover states, and padding — all controlled from the Elementor Style tab without touching code.
  • Section heading — optional title (with accent colour for inline <span>), subtitle, and description above the grid.
  • Responsive — designed to work across desktop, tablet, and mobile breakpoints.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Elementor 3.0 or higher (free version is sufficient)

Getting Started

  1. Install and activate Elementor (free).
  2. Install and activate DCI Vertical Marquee Widget for Elementor.
  3. Edit any page with Elementor, search for “Vertical Marquee” in the widget panel, and drag it onto your canvas.
  4. Add your cards via the Cards repeater in the Content tab, configure layout options, and style everything from the Style tab.

Support

For support, feature requests, and bug reports please visit dreamcodeinfotech.com.
sections.installation:
From the WordPress Plugin Directory (recommended)

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for DCI Vertical Marquee Widget.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now, then Activate.

Via FTP

  1. Unzip the plugin and upload the dci-vertical-marquee-widget folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin via Plugins → Installed Plugins.
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor Pro?

No. The plugin works with the free version of Elementor.

How many cards can I add?

There is no hard limit. You can add as many cards as you need via the Cards repeater in the Content tab.

Can I use it as a portfolio or gallery section?

Yes. Add images, titles, descriptions, category tags, and an optional link per card to build a scroll-reactive portfolio or image gallery.

Does it work with WordPress 7.0?

Yes. The plugin has been tested with WordPress 7.0 (the latest release as of May 2026) and Elementor 4.0.

Is the animation accessible?

The plugin respects the visitor’s prefers-reduced-motion browser setting by halting the CSS-driven animation when motion reduction is preferred.
